occurrences.subsection_title: Here Begins the Section on Practice
occurrences.snippet: Through balanced āhāra and vihāra, and keeping to the vow of brahmacarya, one should patiently train the breath, the tongue and the fingers.

occurrences.subsection_title: Here Begins the Section on Practice
occurrences.snippet: So, by reforming āhāra and vihāra in this way, try to bring simplicity into life. Then, while keeping brahmacarya, one should practise the prāṇa (breath), jihvā (tongue) and finger…

occurrences.subsection_title: Here Begins the Section on Practice
occurrences.snippet: That is, one should perfect the prāṇa (breath) by prāṇāyāma (breath control), the tongue by ṭa and ka, and the fingers by vyāyāma (exercise).
Sādhanā of the Prāṇa (Practice of the Breath)
